fields.name: urls
fields.label: Addresses
fields.hint: One web address a line. Add -> and a name to save it under that name: https://example.com/a.jpg -> Garden.jpg. Lines starting with # are left out.

fields.name: folder
fields.label: Folder in the assets
fields.hint: Made when the first file comes in. Empty for the assets folder itself.

fields.name: existing
fields.label: A file that is already there

options.label: Keep both: number the new one

fields.name: autoDownload
fields.label: Download new addresses by themselves
fields.hint: Each address in the list is downloaded once, when the scene next renders. Change a line to download it again.

options.label: Auto: high contrast where the panel shows no color

downloadToAssets.name: Download to assets
downloadToAssets.description: Downloads files from the web into the frame's assets folder a chunk at a time, and lists the folder's files to delete.
